comment: Stations are pinned explicitly so results are reproducible. Nearest is not assumed best.
source: NOAA Integrated Surface Database (ISD) via AWS Open Data (s3://noaa-isd-pds, s3://noaa-global-hourly-pds)

mappings.rationale: Met Office synoptic climate station with a long, continuous hourly record and 1-hour precipitation. Cranfield (03557399999, ~27 km) is closer but is an aerodrome METAR series; Church Lawford is preferred for climatological precipitation and wind statistics.

alternatives.note: Closer geographically; aerodrome METAR. Not used for the MVP.
